::: {.callout-warning icon=false title="class test ("Klassenarbeit") — Niveau M (45 minutes)"}
**Time.** 45 minutes. **Total.** 30 points.
:::

### Task 1 — Listening (8 BE)

Listen twice.

> "My name is Sam. I get up at 6:30. I have breakfast at 7. I leave home at 7:30. School starts at 8. I finish at 1:20."

1. Get up: ___ . 2. Breakfast: ___ . 3. Leave home: ___ . 4. Finish school: ___ .

### Task 2 — Reading (8 BE)

Read.

> "On Sundays Lina wakes up late. She has a long breakfast with her family. After breakfast she meets Sam in the park. They play chess for an hour. In the evening she does her homework."

1. When does she wake up: ___ . 2. With whom does she have breakfast: ___ . 3. Where does she meet Sam: ___ . 4. Activity: ___ .

### Task 3 — Use of English (8 BE)

**Object pronoun.**

1. I see ___ every day. (Lina = ?)
2. He helps ___ with maths. (you and me = ?)
3. They invite ___ to the party. (you and Lina = ?)
4. We meet ___ at the bus stop. (Sam and Lina = ?)

### Task 4 — Writing (6 BE)

Write 6 sentences about your typical Saturday routine.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Answer key"}
**T1.** 6:30, 7:00, 7:30, 1:20.
**T2.** late, family, in the park, chess.
**T3.** her / us / you / them.
**T4.** Open.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Notenschlüssel (von 30)"}
| 28–30 | 1 | 24–27 | 2 | 20–23 | 3 |
| 15–19 | 4 |  9–14 | 5 |  0–8  | 6 |
:::
